scope: metadata-only audit of HELMET's NarrativeQA and summarization model-judge path; no API credential was inspected; no API request was sent; no batch or file was created; no evaluation data was read; no judge output was generated; no model score was computed

runtime_audit.correction: the earlier seed=null field reflects direct judge-constructor inspection only; OpenAIModel's default seed=42 is passed to every Chat Completions batch request

model_page.observation: gpt-4o-2024-05-13 is listed as a deprecated snapshot

observations: seed is a deprecated beta parameter
same-seed deterministic sampling is best-effort and not guaranteed
system_fingerprint is the documented signal for backend changes that may affect determinism
API data are not used to train OpenAI models unless the customer opts in
default abuse-monitoring logs may retain prompts and responses for up to 30 days
batch and file application state is retained until deleted
the table marks /v1/batches and /v1/files as not Zero Data Retention eligible

judge_surfaces.missing_or_unparseable_handling: excluded from numerator and denominator when output or JSON is absent; partial-key JSON can fail after warning

judge_surfaces.parser: last non-greedy brace-delimited JSON object with fenced-JSON fallback
judge_surfaces.missing_or_unparseable_handling: entire example excluded when any of three calls is absent or unparseable

reproducibility_failures: the exact judge snapshot is deprecated and organization availability was not queried
OpenAI documents seed as best-effort rather than guaranteed determinism
HELMET does not preserve or gate on system_fingerprint in scored artifacts
only one judge trial is made per requested subscore
the OpenAI SDK version is unpinned
parse failures change the effective denominator rather than hard-failing a frozen sample set
score keys, integer types, rubric ranges, and recall/precision denominators are not validated
raw long-QA judge reasoning and output are absent from the scored JSON
summarization key-point artifacts and real-data identities remain unqualified
no cost, retry, rate-limit, regional-processing, or remote-deletion contract is frozen

minimum_future_protocol: qualify the exact real-data payloads and authority to transmit every prompt field
freeze model availability, endpoint, SDK, all request parameters, region, retention controls, deletion workflow, and cost ceiling
preserve raw request/response identities, request IDs, seed, system_fingerprint, usage, and parse status for every call
hard-fail mixed fingerprints, missing outputs, invalid JSON, wrong keys/types/ranges, or denominator drift
run preregistered repeated judgments to estimate item-level and aggregate stability
construct a blinded human-labeled calibration set with released item identities and adjudication rules
qualify any local replacement against that human set and the exact historical rubric without using a newer judge as if it were the same benchmark
version and rename the evaluation if the model, rubric, prompt, parser, or missingness policy changes

decision.required_next: after data rights and payload qualification, freeze a versioned judge protocol that preserves every raw response/fingerprint, forbids denominator drift, validates score schemas, establishes retention/deletion/cost authority, and passes repeated human-calibrated stability; otherwise retain NarrativeQA and summarization as failed gates
